# gws CLI: Google People reference

💳 Curated by Skill Harbor — the full Google People API v1 reference for the `gws` CLI: contactGroups, otherContacts, people, searchContacts and listDirectoryPeople, including the real-world subtleties (warmup before search, expiring sync tokens). The first People/Contacts fiche in the catalog — no equivalent in lot 31, 32 or 33. By @googleworkspace, listed here with credit to its creator. Honest caveats: requires the `gws` binary and a Google account (browser OAuth is free; the domain directory generally needs a paid Google Workspace account); install the prerequisite `googleworkspace-cli-gws-shared` first. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use.
